text:
morgan: partner webhook scan spotted a Vault payload with an old KMS-wrapped blob :eyes:

sara: which key/role? can we lock access?

jamal: blob points at kms_key:projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ringA/cryptoKeys/transit-prod-v1 and vault path secret/data/partners/thirdparty

alex: ciphertext only maybe, but assume exfil. propose: 1) RBAC lock on that vault path 2) enable Vault + KMS audit for 48h 3) rewrap ciphertext to new key + rotate consumer creds 4) notify partner

morgan: owners: RBAC=sara, audit/forensics=jamal, rewrap+kms=alex. I'll lead comms.

sara: applying deny to legacy svcaccs, leaving app-tier-svcacct. pushing infra PR. ETA 8m.

jamal: enabling audit on Vault leader and forwarding to splunk. cmd: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log log_raw=true` then add KMS sink. posting grep results in ~10m.

alex: rewrap plan: create transit-prod-v2, re-encrypt blobs (canary in staging), update Vault transit config to v2, disable v1. throttled batch job scheduled 2026-03-23T18:30Z

oncall-bot: maintenance window 2026-03-23T18:30Z-18:40Z scheduled

morgan: jamal please list principals that read that path in last 7d.

jamal: initial grep shows app-tier-svcacct, legacy-ingest-sa, deploy-bot. legacy-ingest access at T-72h. adding legacy-ingest and deploy-bot to creds rotation list.

sara: RBAC PR merged and applied. monitoring for failures; will rollback if anything breaks.

alex: starting staging rewrap canary now; will report status.

morgan: opening incident channel and partner note. keep thread short for runbook.

oncall-bot: incident channel created: #incident-vault-kms-4167777777
